title: Packed Shell-Epoch and Variable-Depth Wire Format
what_it_does: Versioned variable-depth wire grammar (CW_WIRE_V1) with three packet depths: SHELL_ONLY, SHELL_PLUS_COARSE, FULL. Shell and epoch share a compressed composite token (coarse*9 + shell); short packets omit unused epoch components, extended packets carry them; exact encode/decode round-trip at every depth. The shell supplies the radius (resolve_shell_radius_m), so a decoded packet never reports altitude missing. 8<->0 is an explicit shell_closure_transition flag, not integer equality. Ambiguous untagged legacy packets return a typed CANDIDATE_ALIAS_SET. to_shell_epoch conforms to shell_epoch.schema.json.
negative_results: The 8<->0 closure is stored source ontology and surfaced as an explicit flag; shell 8 is never silently treated as equal to shell 0.
An untagged legacy token string that admits more than one depth is returned as an alias set, not forced to one packet.
A decoded packet is a reversible codec result, not a measured altitude or a proven epoch.

claims.statement: The packed shell-epoch wire format serializes and inverts exactly at every variable depth, with the shell supplying the radius.

privacy_check: CLEAN - synthetic/public packets only; no private source narrative.
